brief: Prioritise Aldergrove Bend for pre-event attention before the forecast heat event, as units of advanced age with high loading have a reduced margin against mechanical failure and are at risk of failing under the thermal cycling of a multi-day event [MG-023]. Where this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period [MG-021].
